profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Sigma Computing building cutting-edge, scalable solutions that empower users to explore and analyze data effortlessly. 

Recently, I developed an encryption service using Go, improving performance and enabling customer managed keys. My work involves designing and developing high-performance applications that elevate the modern data experience.

Previously, I was an engineer at Lifion, where I led the Client Management Team. I developed microservices and frontend applications using TypeScript, GraphQL, Node.js, and React. I also architected and deployed a React UI with a GraphQL backend to streamline complex ETL processes.

Before that, I co-founded Safety Spot, Inc., a cloud-based SaaS platform designed to modernize health and safety processes. As the technical co-founder, I led a team in building an IoT management platform, developed APIs for mobile applications, and shipped multiple products, including an e-commerce platform and an LMS system.

I thrive on solving challenging and complex problems, designing efficient architectures, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to build impactful software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical Lead of the Client Management Team
- Worked primarily with Node, Typescript, GraphQL and React, as well as distributed systems and micro-service architecture using Kubernetes, MySQL, & AWS infrastructure.
- Mentor junior developers, strategic planning for client management team, interviewing candidates, support team in day to day work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed & built a full-stack web application to provide a UI for client onboarding. Built GraphQL API and a React front-end.
- Contributed in implementing stream-driven backend ETL algorithms to reduce client implementation time. Improved data load process that took several hours, to a few minutes.

positions.title: Co-Founder, Lead Developer
positions.locationName: New Orleans, LA | Los Angeles, CA
positions.description:
Safety Spot is a next generation Health, Safety and Environmental all-in-on management platform.
- Lead of the Engineering Team.
- Full-stack development using Ruby on Rails, Heroku, AWS, JSON API's, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery, React.js, D3.js

Led development team in building:
- IoT integrated API, hardware devices connected to the software management platform.
- Back-end API for mobile application, connection between RoR back-end and React Native app.
- E-Commerce platform, allow for monetary transactions using Braintree API
- LMS platform, learning management system to create training and track enrollment

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Shell's Carmon Creek Static Mechanical Engineering group.

-	Consulting mechanical engineer with Shell’s International Exploration and Production branch for the Carmon Creek project.
-	Design and development of the plant’s hydrocarbon drainage and transfer systems, including pumps, piping and liftstations.
-	Interfaced with multiple engineering disciplines including civil, process, electrical and operations to ensure prompt completion of action items related to mechanical design.
-	Assigned with design of P&IDs drawings.
-	Assigned to lead meetings when project manager was unavailable.

positions.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analyst
positions.description:
-	Performed CFD analysis in thermal storage projects for client of ReactWell Inc.
-	Designed a storage tank using commercial CAD software.
-	Performed a thermal analysis on the heat storage capabilities of tank.
-	Optimized flow and temperature conditions in the design
-	Software used includes Autodesk Inventor, Simulation CFD, Solidworks.

positions.title: Helpdesk Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked with customer service to successfully troubleshoot various computer and network issues.
- Developed vast knowledge of computer troubleshooting.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description:
-	Assisted AT&T engineers both in the field and in office environments to design and implement new infrastructure for the Greater New Orleans fiber optic network.
-	Made regular field visits to evaluate and select future work sites.

projects.title: CFD Analysis of Lid-driven Cavity with a Moving Boundary
projects.description:
- Modified a benchmark CFD problem to study the transient effects of a moving boundary.
- Analysis included relation between steady-flow codes and time variant coding.
- Developed steady flow code for lid-driven cavity analysis.

projects.title: Thermal Power Cycle in a Nuclear Power Plant
projects.description: - Thermal analysis of the power generated for a rankine cycle in a nuclear power plant.
